newsitem.title: USA: Horace Mann Educators Corp Q3 net down.
newsitem.headline: Horace Mann Educators Corp Q3 net down.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: Q3 1996 includes $0.01 a share loss from realized investments.
(All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: Operating income was $0.70 a share on a diluted basis for the third quarter of 1996 and $2.05 for the first nine months, compared with $0.73 and $1.84, respectively, in the comparable periods a year ago.

Third-quarter results include after-tax losses from catastrophes of $5.5 million, or $0.24 a share, including Hurricane Fran and Hurricane Bertha. That compares to catastrophe losses of $1.5 million, or $0.06, for the same period last year. Excluding the impact of catastrophes, operating income a share during the quarter increased to $0.94 cents from $0.79 for the third quarter of 1995.
